description: Manage the user's saved searches: named snapshots of their job preferences, with optional email alerts for new matches. action "list" shows them; "save" saves the current job preferences as a new search, with an optional name and alerts_enabled; "update" renames one or turns its email alerts on or off; "delete" removes one for good, so call it only when the user asks. Nothing is sent to any employer and nothing is spent. Do not use it to change what the user is matched with; use getmattered_update_job_preferences. Next: getmattered_get_matches.

action.description: list: every saved search. save: save the current job preferences as a new search. update: rename one or turn its email alerts on or off. delete: remove one for good.

alerts_enabled.description: For save and update: true emails the user new matches for this search, false stops the emails.

name.description: For save and update: the name of the search. When save gets none, it names the search after the first role and location.

saved_search_id.description: The saved search, from action list. Required for update and delete.

name: getmattered_manage_saved_searches

deletedId.description: action delete: the search that was deleted.

alertsEnabled.description: True when new matches for this search are emailed to the user.

savedSearchId.description: Pass as saved_search_id to update or delete.

saved.description: action save or update: the search after the change.

title: Manage Saved Searches
